title: SpoonCraft
description: Explore the world with 182 mod, fight new bosses and dragons, enjoy unique biomes and improved graphics. Create a unique adventure by enjoying the co-op mode and character customization!
body:
Сборка Minecraft: SpoonCraft
Welcome to a world where your Minecraft dreams become a reality! This build includes 182 mods that turn every game into an unforgettable adventure. Discover completely new horizons with improved world generation, unique biomes, and exciting stories.
Here's what awaits you:

- New Bosses: Prepare for battles with powerful dragons and legendary creatures. Each boss has its own unique abilities and tactics, making every encounter truly memorable!

- Improved Visualization: The build includes graphical mods that add an incredible atmosphere to the game. Previously unnoticed locations will take on new life with improved lighting, textures, and weather effects.

- New World Generation: Explore amazing locations, from majestic mountains to dense forests and mysterious dungeons. Each new journey will be filled with surprises and unforgettable discoveries.

- Extensive Content: Over 182 mods

Born in Chaos by mongoose_artist. Used according to the author's open permission for modpacks. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/born-in-chaos

Gnumus Settlement — Created by mongoose_artist.
License/Permissions: The author allows the use of this mod in modpacks. All rights to the assets and code belong to the original creator.

ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Villages (CTOV): https://modrinth.com/mod/ct-overhaul-village/ (Original creator: ChoiceTheorem).
